ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white zones are located on the distal portions of both lobes. A dominant, low-intensity black central region originates from the median notch and extends toward the water line. Fine-scale low-intensity speckling is visible within the white distal regions, particularly on the right lobe (image right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; low-amplitude frequency in the medial regions transitioning to high-amplitude, jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges follow a generally convex curve from the medial region toward the tips, ending in sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinctive high-contrast white clusters and calcified protrusions are visible on the lateral tips and along portions of the trailing edge, consistent with barnacle attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical protrusions and irregular surface texture on the distal tips corresponding to barnacle colonies and associated scarring.
